decision: NX-034 §2.4, D3 (dispatcher 2026-10-11: as recommended). Manifests, signatures, SBOMs, findings and preflight reports are kept forever. Image archives are kept for the 5 most recent releases, every release deployed within the last 90 days, the current release and the previous known-good release; pruning is a dry run unless --apply is given and never touches the current or the previous known-good release. A pruned release can no longer be deployed or rolled back to (§5.5); rebuilding the same commit gives a new release.
